_note: Shared plot-grammar cases (SPEC 2.5), driven from tests/test_plot_grammar_fixture.py (mcuscope.protocol) and tests/webui_js/plot_grammar.test.mjs (webui/plots.js). The two decoders are hand-written mirrors of one grammar in seven places; a case added here is checked on both sides at once. `valid` means the parser returns a definition/sample; `decodes` means the !ps line decodes against its !pd rather than staying a generic event.
